text: 年出货2.6万台、消费占七成，外骨骼机器人会变成大众生意吗？ “在医疗、消费、工业等拥有跨界能力的团队，才能拥有全球定价权。”
text_en: Annual shipments of 26,000 units, consumer segment accounts for 70%; will exoskeleton robots become a mass-market business? 'Only teams with cross-sector capabilities in medical, consumer, and industrial fields can hold global pricing power.'
